# Review — PAN-4479
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — host-repark.test.ts (AC-9) fails on this HEAD after the PAN-4477 merge: its PeerHub fixture lacks the now-required `terminal` dep

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-4479-review-5c3fd825
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4479/.pan/review/agent-pan-4479-review-5c3fd825/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4479 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4479
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4911
- HEAD reviewed: 5c3fd825af4bcb5cfd8910cf3eab75a6ab69e804
- Base / prior cycle SHA: main merge-base 4eb41edbbe1; prior cycle approved 022e2fcd594 (run agent-pan-4479-review-022e2fcd)
- Note: by the time this run finished, the branch had moved to ef5d9fc666f (pushed; it is the PR head) and aeb1739d560 (local plan artifacts). Those commits are outside this run's scope (see Scope Note).

## What changed since the prior cycle
Two merges of `origin/main` bring in PAN-4477 (#4913, shared terminal channel). PAN-4477 makes `terminal` a required `PeerHub` dep (`peer-hub.ts:156`, called unconditionally in `close()` at line 318). It also reworks `SharedConversationView` into an `AdmittedScreen` component with a Conversation/Terminal toggle. I compared the PR's own changed lines before and after the merge. The only differences are the merge resolution in `SharedConversationView.tsx` and an import line in `useSharedJoin.test.tsx`.

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] The PR's re-park integration test crashes on this HEAD — `tests/integration/services/share/host-repark.test.ts:166`
- Severity: ! MUST. AC-9 is an explicit acceptance criterion, and the CI test job is red.
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap (test fixture) introduced by the merge; in_pr_scope. Production code is unaffected: `productionPeerHubDeps` wires `terminal: new TerminalBridge(…)` at `peer-hub.ts:742`.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `startHost()` in this PR's new test builds the `PeerHub` deps without `terminal`, and without `queue`, which PAN-4476 added. `hostA.manager.stop()` calls `dropHost()`, then `hub.close()`, then `this.deps.terminal.close()`. That throws because `terminal` is undefined. The sibling harnesses `join-manager.test.ts` and `peer-hub.test.ts` got the stub in PAN-4477 itself. This file only exists on this branch, so main's merge could not update it. `npm run typecheck` excludes `*.test.ts`, so the missing required field was not caught at compile time.
- Expected / observed / impact: both AC-9 cases should pass. On CI they fail with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'close')` at `peer-hub.ts:318` (from `share-host.ts:548`, `dropHost`, called by `stop` at line 294, called at test lines 277 and 327). Run 41693885286, job `test-shard (2/4)`: "Test Files 1 failed | 578 passed", "Tests 2 failed | 6275 passed". The `test` aggregate check is also red.
- Why the prior cycle missed it: PAN-4477 was not on main when 022e2fcd was reviewed, and that HEAD's CI showed host-repark 2/2 ✓.
- Fix: add the stubs that `join-manager.test.ts` uses to `startHost()`'s `PeerHub` deps: `terminal: { attach: async () => () => undefined, close: () => undefined }` and `queue: { deliver, activity, now }`. Commit ef5d9fc666f already does exactly this (+6 lines, test-only). That commit has not been reviewed or CI-verified in this run.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [ux] The automatic peer reconnect resets the viewer to the Conversation view and briefly shows "Connecting…" — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/sharing/SharedConversationView.tsx`
- Severity: ~ SHOULD. Carried over, and its effect is now larger because of the PAN-4477 merge.
- Trigger: the D-8 auto reconnect calls `subscribe()`. The server's `restart()` then calls `reopen()`, which runs `setState('connecting')`. `body()` renders the "Connecting…" panel for that state, which unmounts `AdmittedScreen`. When `admitted` returns, `AdmittedScreen` remounts with its `surface` state reset to `'conversation'`. So a viewer who had picked Terminal is moved back to Conversation after an automatic reconnect. The manual **Reconnect** button already behaves this way on main.
- Fix: render `<AdmittedScreen {...props} />` for `'connecting'` when `hasHistory` is true, or lift `surface` into `useSharedJoin`.

### [ux] Stale suggestion drafts can survive a kept-content renegotiation — `useSharedJoin.ts`
- Severity: ~ SHOULD. Carried over: `drafts` is cleared only in `resetContent()`, and a new peer's sync sends only the non-empty drafts. Fix: clear `drafts` on `onReady`.

### [correctness] `resume()` leaves an open socket if hub creation throws — `share-host.ts` (`resume` catch)
- Severity: ? MAY. Carried over hypothesis; the fix would be `dropHost(code, 'terminate')`.

## Merge resolution check (PAN-4477)
- `AdmittedScreen` correctly combines both sides. The PR's banner precedence (reconnecting, then host-disconnected, then lost) is used on both the terminal and conversation surfaces. `showTimeline = hasHistory` (FR-11) is kept. `showToggle` is extended to `reconnecting` with history, which matches the host-disconnected rule. `case 'reconnecting'` renders `<AdmittedScreen>` when there is history. Because `body()` returns the same component at the same tree position for `admitted`, `host-disconnected` and `reconnecting`, the selected surface survives a join-socket reconnect. Only the `'connecting'` detour noted above loses it.
- On the server side, `PeerHub.close()` now also closes the terminal bridge. `dropHost` is the only caller from `ShareManager`, and a same-process reconnect does not close the hub (D-1). So the terminal bridge survives a host-socket reconnect, which is correct.

## Verification
- `test-shard (2/4)` and `test`: **fail** on 5c3fd825. Log `job 126119732123`, lines 9574–9622: the two host-repark cases fail and every other test passes.
- `test-shard 1,3,4/4`, `test-e2e`, `lint`, `lint-group (core/effect/skills/state)`, `build (22)`, `Clean install + server smoke test`, and `Prompt change trailer gate`: pass. `Non-blocking flake lane` was still pending when I read the checks.
- Confirmed with `git show 5c3fd825af4:tests/integration/services/share/host-repark.test.ts` that this HEAD has no `terminal:` and no `queue:` in the fixture.
- No local test run; the CI log gives a deterministic reproduction.

This run was assigned 5c3fd825 and does not review or approve ef5d9fc6. The next review cycle only needs to confirm that ef5d9fc6's CI `test-shard` jobs show host-repark 2/2 ✓.
